name: Horcajo de las Torres (Spain)
description: White field with a border of alternating red and white triangles, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Horcajo de las Torres (a white pall on green above a tower on red).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 20 March 1996 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 77 of 22 April 1996); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a white cloth with an indented border of alternating red and white teeth and the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: indented border of red and white teeth
